title: Chart value axis starts at 0 unless a value is below 0
pre_body:
Preconditions

  1. User: you are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. Location: you are in a location (workplace) where no invoice has been created today.
  3. Browser: you use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
  4. Timing: Today, in that location, a credit was issued against an invoice from an earlier week, larger than today's sales (e.g. $300.00), so today's revenue is negative; no invoice is created today.
